The spin dryer allows the clothes (or whatever you're washing, towels & blankets included!) to be ALMOST DRY with one, five minute spin cycle!!!!  I was very impressed with this!!  I use an old-fashioned folding rack to hang my clothes, and they dry in very little time (an hour or two, depending on the fabric...sometimes, less time...)  ***The downside:****  It takes awhile to fill the washer, twice...once to wash, and another to rinse!  We use a hose connected to the sink, which is better than filling small buckets!  :)  There is a considerable amount of lint, so I suggest turning your clothes inside out, and investing in a few lint brushes! This is a small price to pay for the convenience of having your own washer at home!  Excellent Purchase!!

- fitted queen sheet, fitted regular sheet, and 2 pillow cases

I’m delighted with this little machine. Live in a 5th wheel with three daughters, and those trips to the laundromat were doing me in. This washer does everything as advertised, but I think it’s even better than they tell you! I’ve had it running all day / every day since I received it (early!), and our clothes are perfectly clean. The spinner is really powerful and removes the vast majority of the water - then I hang on a drying rack (also Amazon) and they are ready in a few hours.
With so little room to spare, I keep the washer in the shower - easy to lift out when we shower - and the shower hose is ideal for filling the washer. Draining is a breeze. It can handle jeans, towels, sweatshirts etc as well as the lighter weights. It took a couple of tries to get the hang of it, figuring out how much was “8 pounds of clothes”, but that powerful motor and excellent design washes everything really clean. I love it!

I've had this washing machine for about 2 months. I really enjoy its easy to use nature but the one thing that I really dislike is the inability to drain the water out of the machine if its sitting on the ground. If you have a standing shower (not tub) or a drain in the floor you will be able to drain easily. However, if you only have a tub/shower combo I have been having to pick up the whole machine and lift it over the tub to drain the water (which is heavy once it has water in it).

Overall, this washer is great for apartment living but you will need a sturdy stand in order to drain easily and it is not great for extra-large/heavy objects.

When washing: I can usually get a pretty large load in of small-medium sized objects but this washing machine is hard to use for my queen size bed sheets or large towels since they won't fit into the spinner or will get too water-logged/heavy for the washer to really clean in.

Helpful tips: Drain the water often otherwise the spinner will not dry your clothes well. You may also need to buy a separate tub to connect from your shower to your washer so it fits.

I bought my 1st twin tub washer at the start of the covid pandemic. It was used and abused for 3 months before I tossed it. So I replaced the old one with this Rossum mini twin tub. I'm really happy with it. Its larger than my old one so I can do more wash. But the lessons I learned from my last machine. 1) don't overatuff the tub. 2) be super careful of the drain hose. My 5 year old kept closing the top on the drain hose and it broke. They are almost impossible to replace once they are damaged. 3) follow directions on weight and don't bog down the motor. 4) don't go crazy with laundry detergents 5) make sure the machine is dry as possible while not in use. 5
6) wash and rinse 2/3 times for best cleaning. Option but recommended.. I use a washer machine cleaner. Run a short cycle with the cleaner, then fully drain. Give the inside a light spray. I use Pure Sense washing machine and deodorizer. Its eco friendly and smells great. I mention this only because after some time the hoses can get smelly. Running vinegar and water should probably work as well. I dont really think this machine is too loud. It makes alot of noise if the spinner has an unbalanced load. I also find the machine a little rough on towels. I bring my towels and blankets to a laundry mat. Otherwise this machine has saved me a large sum of money. Definitely a great buy, especially under the current pandemic situation.
